## Closure Result

Lead Hub launched on 2026-09-15 and the LeadLab Director accepted the application. The project is conditionally closed at the project level. Remaining operational controls continue as active follow-on work and are not represented as complete by this closure.

## Accepted Outcome

- The production launch is recorded as an actual project milestone.
- `DEP-07 (LeadLab Director final OK)` is `Met` and `ACT-04 (Obtain LeadLab Director final approval before the Option B launch or SharePoint fallback decision)` is `Closed`.
- `ACT-25 (Schedule the client staging review and confirm the go/no-go contingency)`, `ACT-26 (Confirm staging HTTPS and enforce synthetic-data-only review until HTTPS is active)`, and `ACT-44 (Implement and verify optional calendar Location and Live broadcast link fields)` are `Closed` by PM direction.
- Postmark SMTP is confirmed for staging and production. Participant-data rules, administrator-only data access, and staging and production email verification are recorded as confirmed in the current reconciliation.
- No post-launch usage, benefit, service-level, or complete target-environment performance measures are recorded.

## Lessons

Three lessons were proposed in the PM-09 review:

1. Feature completion and operational readiness are separate control questions.
2. Provider selection does not prove full mail-service operability.
3. Closure records must match the current platform and phase.

These lessons were not added to the canonical lessons register because the approval confirmed the closure boundary, not individual lesson acceptance.
